plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
summary: The developer portal runs and is tested against in-process stand-ins for Network, Events and Media. It is not deployed, the OAuth client and grants it needs are not registered in Network yet, and openvibe.codes still serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder.
works: Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (authorization code + PKCE S256), session tokens in httpOnly cookies

Projects, members, apps, credentials (rotate, revoke), grants (request, approve, deny, revoke), quotas and audit over Network's /api/v1/projects API with the person's own token; Network's errors shown as Network answered them
Client secrets shown once, in the create/rotate response only, with no-store; never stored or logged (tested)
Scope editor offering only capabilities apps can be granted (public, or partner when in the allowance)

Docs generated at boot from openvibe-contracts v0.26.0 and openvibe-sdk v0.2.2: contracts with field tables and fixtures, capability catalog, event types, SDK reference; service registry read live from Network with its health
OAuth callback helper and a test callback that never exchanges the code
Webhook signature verifier (server or in-browser) and signed sample deliveries for catalogued event types
Playgrounds (Media upload, Events publish) that run with the app's own token and refuse without the grant
App and mod manifest validation; release metadata (draft, publish, deprecate, revoke) with codes.app.* events through the SDK outbox; trust tiers as staff-set metadata
Policy pages rendered from the published ADRs; licensing read from package metadata
notYet: Not deployed; the Network OAuth client `codes` and the events.event.publish grant are not registered
The Events playground cannot run for any app: events.event.publish is internal in openvibe-contracts v0.26.0 and Network never grants it to apps
The Media playground needs Network to accept sandbox tokens for openvibe.media (DEV_SANDBOX_AUDIENCES) and Media to have a tenant per project id; neither exists yet
codes.release.manage and codes.release.read are proposals; until Contracts releases them no app can hold the release-management grant
No usage, trace or error dashboards: no service reports per-project usage yet
Billing sandbox, Chat bot and Realtime playgrounds; CLI and scaffolding; templates; project data export
Consent screen for third-party production apps (a Network gap)
